title: Forward coherence of the fixed normalized tensor comparisons
statement: With the same coefficient reduction data and tensor coherence and normalization hypotheses as lem-coef-normalized-tensor-associativity, the forward tensorator associativity equation holds for R.reductionTensor and every R.finiteTensor(n): F(a_S) followed by μ_{P,Q⊗V} and (1⊗μ_{Q,V}) equals μ_{P⊗Q,V} followed by (μ_{P,Q}⊗1) and a_T, for arbitrary derived inputs P,Q,V.

source.place: Tag 07A4, lemma-pullback-tensor-product; the forward strong-monoidal associativity equation underlying the inverse comparison equation.

proof.text: Choose simultaneous flat-term K-flat representatives of three inputs and their total tensor products. Apply the representative normalization squares hR and hF and the associator_model fields supplied by hT.

On every triple pure-tensor summand both routes reassociate to the same scalar-reduced triple tensor with the same signed-total convention. Tensor generators and coproduct extensionality prove equality of the chain maps.

Localize the chain-map equality and cancel the specified representative isomorphisms. Naturality transports it from the chosen K-flat representatives to arbitrary derived inputs, including zero inputs and index zero.

proof_origin.place: Tag 07A4, lemma-pullback-tensor-product; forward strong-monoidal coherence on normalized representatives.

from.place: The forward equation is the categorical form whose inverse is the assigned target.

        (coefficientFiniteDerivedExtension l E W n) (R.finiteTensor n)
